case.background: You are investigating an idealized pendulum in a small-angle laboratory. Vary only the listed controls, inspect the period measurements, and infer a predictive response law.
initial_observations: A suspended bob repeats its motion at a regular interval.
The cause of changes in that interval is not given.

controls.description: Distance from the pivot to the bob's center.
controls.name: length_m

controls.description: Small release angle from the vertical.
controls.name: release_angle_deg

instruments.description: Pendulum rig with a ruler, balance, protractor, and stopwatch.
instruments.name: simple_pendulum

notes: The rig is calibrated only for the listed small release angles.
The stopwatch reports measurements to the nearest 0.01 s.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'expression'. FinalSubmission.parameters must equal {'outputs': {READOUT: EXPR, ...}} with exactly these readouts: period_s. EXPR is the shared family-neutral JSON arithmetic tree over public controls. Supported operators are: add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, negate, exp, log, sin, maximum, step. No candidate law family or truth-specific parameter slots are supplied.

readouts.description: Mean time for one complete oscillation.
readouts.name: period_s
